articles.title: Trump’s DHS Chief Offers Wild Justification for ICE Killings
articles.description: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin says fatal shootings by ICE agents are ultimately part and parcel of the greater good. And sometimes it ends with the target winding up dead,” Tapper noted, pointing out the deaths of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo and Joan Sebastián Durán Guerrero in Texas and Maine this July. Read more at The Daily Beast.
